authority.note: Sealed BEFORE any gate's holdout contrast was computed. Sparse independent signal = SEM-012 Visual CRT Arm A and Arm B entries from visual_crt.driver.run_arm (same detector and duplicate rule as F-081). FM-054 agree is a magnitude/time prior (SEM-028), not the entry. y_mfe_r / y_time_to_mfe are path labels, not F-081 walk R and not book PnL. economic_claims_allowed stays false until mt00==PASS and mt01_matrix_coverage==COMPLETE. P-GOAL-04 is not opened. A diagnostic sign-match is NOT G001. Not a retune of MC-MRPRIOR / F-094.

population.inclusion_rule: MEASUREMENT CORPUS = data/mt5/XAUUSD_M15.csv ONLY (47275 bars, sha256 4d73f5cebe33ec91c5312340337eb62c2cf1f49060c91c42761bf631b26aba56). SPARSE SIGNAL POPULATION = SEM-012 v2 entries from research.visual_crt.driver.run_arm for arms A and B independently (Arm A = displacement-close, Arm B = retest-close; one shot per (pool, direction) until pool replaced; at most one open trade at a time). Each entry e resolved to its clean label row (decision_ts = e.entry_ts, side = e.direction) from results/clean_labels/XAUUSD/20260723T083443Z/clean_labels (TN_ENV_CLEAN_L2). One unit = one such (entry_ts, direction, visual_arm) row with finite y_mfe_r and trend_bias in {+1,-1}. SUCCESS GATE uses HOLDOUT units only (entry_ts >= 2025-12-24 19:15:00). Four diagnostic gates: A-S, A-T, B-S, B-T.
population.exclusion_rule: EXCLUDED: the every-bar x side clean_labels grain (SEM-028/SEM-029 / F-086); SEM-026 mother-range inside-close (that is SEM-030 / F-094); the SEM-012 trade-ledger y (F-081/F-084 forward_walk R); CRT spine events/telemetry; opportunities.outcome (F-022). trend_bias=0 rows dropped from PRIMARY. F-086 236-bar stride holdout is NOT this split. F-081 last-20%-of-entries OOS is NOT this split. Hour-of-day and session cells are OUT OF PATH for the success gate (F-066).

features.point_in_time_rule: Sparse signal (SEM-012) is computed from only bars at or before the entry bar (causal run_arm). trend_bias (FM-054) is the stored t=0 ternary on that bar. y_mfe_r and y_time_to_mfe use path labels after t. F-051: PRIMARY uses only FM-054 sign. F-066 session/hour OUT OF PATH for the gate.

sparse_signal.formula_ref: visual_crt.driver.run_arm(bars, arm) one (entry_ts, direction) per SEM-012 v2 entry

labels.y_definition: Arm S: y = clean_labels y_mfe_r on the sparse entry's (entry_ts, direction) row (TN_ENV_CLEAN_L2 horizon_excursion, exit-agnostic, max_forward=40). Arm T: y = y_time_to_mfe on that row (nulls dropped). NOT stream mfe, NOT y_tp1, NOT y_R_net, NOT F-081 rr_gross/rr_net, NOT SEM-027 ΔMFE.
labels.sign_convention: Positive contrast_S means the agreeing sparse entry printed more MFE than the disagreeing entry. Positive contrast_T means the agreeing entry took more bars to print its MFE.

components.name: not_a_trade
components.bps_or_formula: y_mfe_r / y_time_to_mfe are not book PnL. No spread, commission, or slippage is applied. SEM-015 is OUT OF PATH. F-081 12bps walk is a different object.

exits.intrabar_rule: Inherited from the sealed clean_labels protocol (horizon_excursion, exit-agnostic). This experiment does not re-walk SL/TP and does not use F-081 ledger R. run_arm still walks internally ONLY to apply SEM-012 one-open-trade suppression (duration_candles); that walk's R is not PRIMARY y.
not_equal_to: F-081 forward_walk net R as this y
SEM-026 ledger SL/TP walk as this y

splits.embargo: 96 M15 bars between last train entry and first holdout entry
splits.purge: drop train entries whose 40-bar label horizon overlaps holdout start
splits.oos_fraction_or_dates: last 20% of corpus bars by index; first holdout entry timestamp 2025-12-24 19:15:00 (idx 37820). Identical calendar to MC-MRANGE/MC-ASYM/MC-MAGPRIOR/MC-MRPRIOR. F-081 last-20%-of-entries OOS is a different split and is not spent. F-086 stride holdout of 236 bars is a different split and is not spent.

metrics.success_gate: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, PER GATE. Four gates: visual-arm A|B × prior-arm S|T. For each: holdout both agree/disagree cells n>=30 AND sign(holdout contrast)==sign(train contrast). Meeting a clause is NOT economic validation while economic_claims_allowed is false. Passing A-S does not pass B-S or A-T. Bonferroni 4.
metrics.kill_criteria: Any outcome including n=0 or n<30 is registered. Changing y, the sparse signal definition, the agree rule, holdout date, embargo, purge, or dropping a visual arm after seeing holdout y requires a NEW MC-* id. Do not promote session/hour into PRIMARY. Do not turn this into a side picker. Do not retune SEM-012 geometry. Do not reopen F-081/F-084 or F-094.

pipeline_identity.config_version_source: NOT the production config path. Object frozen in docs/research/visual_crt_prior_object.md. ACTIVE_VERSION is never written.

prohibited_substitutions.forbidden: Count the every-bar clean_labels grain, CRT TRADE_OPENED, SEM-026 inside-close, or F-081 walk R as PRIMARY units
Use opportunities.outcome, stream mfe, y_R_net, SEM-027 ΔMFE, or F-081 rr_gross as this y
Treat y_mfe_r as net expectancy or apply 12bps as if this were a trade book
Substitute y_tp1 or F-081 forward_walk net R for stored horizon_excursion labels
Spend F-086's 236-bar stride holdout, use F-081 entry-fraction OOS, or retune the split after seeing holdout y
Present diagnostic sign-match as G001, drop a visual arm after seeing holdout, or treat this as a side picker
Skip L3 dataset_integrity.validate_dataset on the candle CSV
Use hour_of_day, session, or trend_strength as the PRIMARY state; use trend_bias to choose side; substitute the every-bar grain or SEM-026 for the sparse signal

open_risks_non_blocking: SEM-012 one-open suppression uses forward_walk duration; that walk's R is not PRIMARY y
F-086 stride holdout remains unspent by design
F-081 entry-fraction OOS remains unspent by design
Stored labels inherit TN_ENV_CLEAN_L2 PIT_UNCLEAN_STORED_FEATURES (F-051); PRIMARY uses FM-054 sign only
